asked.item: Second Instagram keeps logging into first account

verdict.reason: The pages explain why the first account is reused and give the Switch account and private window fixes.

steps.text: Your browser remembers the active social login, so the authorization screen might reuse your first Instagram account.
Go to Accounts, select Connect account > Instagram, then on the Instagram consent screen click the three dots (···) in the top right and choose "Switch account".
If Instagram keeps selecting the first account, use a private window with the intended Instagram login and the intended Blotato login.
